items.source_en:
A range of antique Taris computers, ranging from the late 1980's to the mid 2000's.

Computers have existed in some form since Charles Babbage's Difference Engine in 1822. The years from the mid 20th century into the early 21st century were known for some of the greatest advances in computing technology, as computers shrank from gigiantic room-sized devices filled with vacuum tubes, to small boxes filled with microprocessors like the ones you see here.

items.source_en:
To: Dantoo Town
From: Emma Wexley
Subject: Good news

For those who haven't heard, we got some good news. The doc has approved Helga for limited duty on-site here at the Rock. With some luck, she'll be back in the field in a few weeks, but we want to take things slow and take all the necessary precautions. 

In the meantime, let's all give her some encouragement and support. No one wants to be stuck indoors while there are people out there who need our help, but sometimes that's the way it's got to be. I know you'll all be there for her while she heals up.
items.legacy_ko:
수신: 단투 타운
발신: 엠마 웩슬리
제목: 좋은 소식

그동안 다들 헬가에게 격려와 응원을 보내주세요. 우리 도움이 필요한 사람들이 밖에 있는데 실내에만 갇혀 있고 싶은 사람은 없겠지만, 때로는 어쩔 수 없는 일이니까요. 헬가가 회복하는 동안 다들 곁을 지켜줄 거라 믿습니다.

I... I think I'm being invited into the lab...

items.source_en:
Ongoing operations require immediate support. Take only what you can commit to.

• Builders needed to reinforce outer structures and expand shelter capacity
• Lookouts required for rotating watch across perimeter zones
• Orbital watch posting open. Monitor traffic and report unusual movement
• Mechanics needed to maintain speeders and repair field equipment
• Communications operators requested to manage relay uptime and signal routing
• Supply runners needed for low-profile transport between settlements
• Security volunteers required for night patrol and checkpoint duty
• Agricultural support needed to maintain food production and storage
• Scouts requested to map safe routes and identify Imperial activity

All roles are critical. Reliability matters more than experience. Check in with your local coordinator before deployment.
